name: application-diff-stat-bar
title: Diff Stat Bar
description: Added/removed line-count summary components with a proportion bar for pull request and commit change overviews.
useWhen: Added/removed line-count summary components with a proportion bar for pull request and commit change overviews.
avoidWhen: Avoid diff stat bar when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Diff Stat Bar uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
